final_synthesis_description: Immediately remedy the guest's harm through service recovery (apology, replacement, or alternative) without admitting fault or conceding authenticity standards, while triaging for any safety or compliance concerns; then conduct a structured post-incident review to distinguish execution error from expectation mismatch, ensuring recovery actions restore adherence to stated standards rather than silently rewriting them.
remaining_disagreements: Degree to which 'fault suspension' should be conditional on safety/allergen/compliance risks versus applied universally
Whether the recovery framing should explicitly protect authenticity language in the moment or only address it during post-incident review
How formally structured the post-incident review should be and who should be involved in determining fault
